14 rooms on the north quay

Sleep above the harbour. Breakfast as the cutters come in.

Hotel Ebbstein is the old net loft on Möwensund's Nordkai - brick below, larch above, the Baltic at the end of the quay. Fourteen rooms, a kitchen that buys from the boats and a bar that stays open as long as the lighthouse.

Getting here

Am Nordkai 7, at the end of the quay

Möwensund lies on the Baltic coast between Kiel and the Danish border. Tap a pin for the way from there.

FAQ

Before you pack

Anything else: reception answers the phone from 7:00 to 22:00.

When can I check in and out?

Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 11:00. Arriving after 22:00? We text you the code for the key safe by the door. A late check-out until 13:00 costs €25 when the room is free that night.

Can I bring my dog?

One dog per room in the Cabin and the Harbour rooms, €15 a night with a blanket and two bowls. Dogs are welcome in the Netzbar, not in the Kombüse at dinner.

When is breakfast?

From 7:30 to 10:30, on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays until 11:00. Catching the 9:15 ferry? We pack you a breakfast the evening before.

What is the city tax?

The town of Möwensund charges €2.80 per adult and night; children under 16 are free. We collect it with the bill and give you the guest card that comes with it - free buses along the coast and the beach without a ticket.

Is there a lift?

No - the net loft is listed and its stairs are steep. Two Harbour rooms are on the ground floor with a step-free shower; ask for one when you book. We carry your luggage up for you.

Can I cancel?

Free of charge until three days before you arrive. Later we charge the first night, unless we let the room again.

Privacy

This site sets no cookies and loads no trackers. The dates you try in the search stay in your browser.

Booking requests

A request goes to reception by email. We keep it for six months if no stay follows; the registration form of a stay is kept for one year, as the law on registration requires.

Your rights

You may ask what we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted: write to privacy@ebbstein.example.
